Restyle this ONE fictional Guarin character as a new rendering of the EXACT SAME costume, pose, silhouette, proportions, equipment, color placement, lighting direction and camera. Keep every costume structure but rebuild how it is drawn and shaded. No captions, text, extra characters or panels.

Render it as raw, rough CHARCOAL AND ETCHED HATCHING tinted with restrained wine-red and taupe pigment. Replace the polished outlines and flat cel fills with bold directional charcoal shadow masses, broken scratch lines, cross-hatching, stippling, scraped dusty highlights and irregular dry contours.
